ns2:course.label: British Lit 1800 to Present
ns2:course.description: Historical and critical study of selected works of British literature after 1800 in chronological sequence. For majors only. Prerequisite: Completion of the Composition I requirement and ENGL 200.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Completion of the Composition I requirement and ENGL 200.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Lit & Arts, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
